definitions.explanation: the degree to which something allows light to pass through, or figuratively, how open and clear something is

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{透明度|とうめいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This lake has high water clarity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{透明度|とうめいど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天候|てんこう}→天候：03558_tenkou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The transparency of the sea changes depending on the weather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{透明度|とうめいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦{海底|かいてい}→海底：13287_kaitei⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{見通|みとお}せる→見通す：18734_mitoosu⟧ほどだ。
examples.english: The sea in Okinawa is so clear that you can see all the way to the ocean floor.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧ (transparent, clear) + ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (degree). Most commonly used to describe the clarity of water in lakes, oceans, and rivers. Also used figuratively for organizational transparency.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {透明度|とうめいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: high transparency/clarity
- {透明度|とうめいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: low transparency
- {透明度|とうめいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure transparency
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{透明度|とうめいど}: water clarity
- {透明度|とうめいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: transparency decreases

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧: transparent, clear — the base adjective describing the property itself
- ⟦{透明性|とうめいせい}→透明性：05576_toumeisei⟧: transparency — used more abstractly for organizational/political transparency
- ⟦{濁|にご}り→濁り：13431_nigori⟧: turbidity, murkiness — the opposite quality
